subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed `sessions_spawn` startup failures stay accepted-then-async and terminalize/log through child session and subagent state, or should sandbox startup be preflighted before returning `accepted`?
rationale: Both shapes can address the silent hang, but the choice changes the documented non-blocking spawn contract, lifecycle events, registry/session state, gateway wait behavior, and the relationship to the broader startup-silence work.

options.title: Terminalize async startup failure
options.body: Keep the documented accepted response, but emit/log a typed startup failure and make registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

options.title: Preflight sandbox before accepted
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation ahead of the accepted response so failures reject immediately, accepting added latency and compatibility impact for existing callers.

options.title: Defer to broader lifecycle work
options.body: Let #58776/#77415 own the lifecycle contract while this issue remains the sandbox-specific live proof case.

recommendation.title: Terminalize async startup failure
recommendation.body: Keep the documented accepted response, but emit/log a typed startup failure and make registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent and broad history across subagent lifecycle, registry, and terminal-state paths touched by the decision.
